description: Source code for Zephyr-based update hub management, including network communication, firmware update handling, and device reporting.

methods.name: bin2hex_str
methods.description: Converts binary data to a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: wait_fds
methods.description: Waits for file descriptors with a network timeout.

methods.name: prepare_fds
methods.description: Prepares file descriptors for polling.

methods.name: metadata_hash_get
methods.description: Calculates hash of metadata and updates package UID.

methods.name: is_compatible_hardware
methods.description: Checks if device hardware is compatible based on metadata.

methods.name: cleanup_connection
methods.description: Closes socket and resets file descriptor array.

methods.name: start_coap_client
methods.description: Initializes and connects a CoAP client over UDP or DTLS.

methods.name: send_request
methods.description: Sends a CoAP request with specified message type, method, and URI path.

methods.name: install_update_cb_sha256
methods.description: Verifies SHA256 checksum of downloaded update.

methods.name: install_update_cb_check_blk_num
methods.description: Checks block number in CoAP response.

methods.name: install_update_cb
methods.description: Handles received CoAP data blocks during firmware download.

methods.name: install_update
methods.description: Performs firmware installation via CoAP block transfer.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Sends a status report over CoAP.

methods.name: probe_cb
methods.description: Processes probe response to check for updates.

methods.name: updatehub_confirm
methods.description: Marks current partition as confirmed.

methods.name: updatehub_reboot
methods.description: Reboots the system.

methods.name: updatehub_probe
methods.description: Probes for available updates and retrieves metadata.

methods.name: updatehub_update
methods.description: Performs firmware update process including download and reboot.

methods.name: autohandler
methods.description: Auto-handles update check and applies update if available.

methods.name: updatehub_autohandler
methods.description: Initializes auto-update handler.
